contest.measure_text: Shall the measure, to strengthen academic excellence, attract and retain teachers, support music/arts/athletics/STEM programs, instructional aides, and for other designated purposes, by imposing a special tax on all real estate parcels, including commercial use, of $0.48/building square foot, with senior exemptions, independent citizen/auditor oversight, subject to a tax cap, for 10 years, generating approximately $18,000,000 annually in local funds for Culver City public schools that the state cannot take be adopted? Supporters: Darrel Menthe; Ross Piro; Culver City Federation of Teachers; CCUSD Association of Classified Employees; Ji Young Denick Opponents: John Derevlany
contest.office: CITY OF CULVER CITY GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION - MEASURE AA
